headline:
تعاون جديد
في Dragon's Dogma 2
label: متوفر الآن
note: reel_check (reel-check.md not released). Story type: OUT NOW / update. Mohammad: 'go ahead with all 4' and 'every Reel video first' (4 Nov). Hook: Delicious in Dungeon's Laios and Marcille come to Dragon's Dogma 2. Why now: Capcom's collaboration is live on PS5, Xbox Series and PC (Gematsu 3 Nov 19:45 EST, Nintendo Life 4 Nov), Switch 2 update 11 Nov PST. Players here: pawns hireable at Riftstones and two outfits given when a save is loaded; pawns and outfits until the 28 Jan 2027 title update (outfits stay usable after). Payoff: Switch 2 on 11 Nov. Footage route: Steam app 2054970 official trailer, a stretch from 14 s, stand-in footage named on screen; the collaboration trailer itself is on YouTube only (unreachable). picture: Dragon's Dogma 2 Steam trailer 14 to 35.6 s (no still). Sound: trailer's own sound. Names: Capcom bracketed. Sensitive: none.
